Job script templates of SLURM clusters

Source: R/remoteComputing.R
slurmTemplate.Rd

Sets up the job script template of a SLURM cluster, once per login node. The templates are kept in tools::R_user_dir("dMod2", "config") and stay across sessions; distributedComputing() on a slurmCluster() takes the one named like the login node of the cluster.

Usage

slurmTemplate(
  login = NULL,
  from = login,
  edit = interactive(),
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

login

The login node, as in slurmCluster(). NULL (default) lists the templates set up.

from

The template to start from: the name of one dMod2 ships, such as "helix", or the path of a job script. Defaults to the shipped template named login.

edit

Logical, opens the template in the editor. Default interactive().

overwrite

Logical. TRUE replaces a template set up before; with FALSE (default) it is kept.

Value

The path of the template, invisibly. Without login the paths of the templates set up, named by login node.

Details

A template is a job script with the placeholders {{ jobname }}, {{ ntasks }} (the number of array tasks), {{ cores }}, {{ memPerCore }}, {{ walltime }} and one line {{ run }}, which runs the tasks of the array task SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID. The lines before {{ run }} that are not comments set up the environment, for example with module load; the build on the login node runs in it as well. A job script of the cluster becomes a template by these placeholders. dMod2 ships one for the bwForCluster Helix, "helix".

See also

distributedComputing(), slurmCluster()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# once per login node, from a job script of the cluster
slurmTemplate("mycluster", from = "~/mycluster.sh")
# the template dMod2 ships for the bwForCluster Helix
slurmTemplate("helix")
slurmTemplate()
} # }
